title: docs(pm-skill): rules-only rewrite of the seven core pm-dispatch references
body:
Part of #15379
Fixes #14986

Rules-only rewrite of the seven core `pm-dispatch` references, under the house style the digest set: one rule per line, at most 120 bytes measured with `wc -c`, plain Chinese with identifiers in backticks, grouped under each file's own sections. Provenance narratives, ruling dates, verbatim quotations, incident post-mortems and rationale tails leave the corpus. Every rule already stated in the rewritten `SKILL.md` is cut rather than repeated, and each file now opens with a single pointer to the SKILL.md section it details. Precedence and the red lines are not restated anywhere here.

**713 to 630 lines across the seven.** 57 of those lines are passages removed outright (Table 2); the rest of the shrink is multi-line bullets re-flowed into single rule lines, which is why the rule count barely moves while the file count does.

Angle-bracket placeholders are spelled as bare placeholder words in this body only, because the body sanitizer eats short angle-bracket fragments even inside backticks. The files keep the original spelling.

**Patch round (head `6000e270d`).** The takeover section of `dispatch-runbook.md` gains the (a)-type check the skills-lane finding asks for: before putting a second dev on a branch another session's dev owns, read the remote branch head, that branch's last push time and the newest `os-dev-report` on the card; any of the three inside the cloud collection boundary means no second dev — wake the branch's own dev with a comment on its PR, and run the takeover protocol only after a full boundary of silence. A fourth line closes the gap the finding is a counter-example to: a dead PM session is not evidence that the dev it created is dead. Four lines, paid inside the file's re-pinned ceiling by merging four adjacent line pairs — the same-round execution rule, the first-touch grading note, the seat-post downgrade action, and the unlock-scan inversion. No prohibition was dropped and the ratchet row stays 241.

## The seven files

- **`dispatch-runbook.md` — 280 to 241.** The dispatch and collection runbook: per-section increments only. Every `出处` header line is gone; the eighteen sections keep their subjects and their order. The cloud-card applicability argument, the read-cost measurements and the seat-post patrol precedent are out; the four cloud lessons, the takeover protocol, the stall-reset gradient, the notification-replay identity triple and the whole dispatch-prompt construction section keep every operative clause, including the verbatim two-sentence forms (file surface, repo-wide pin sweep, same-day churn, the four overlap warnings). The takeover section now opens with the four-line inherited-branch check described above.
- **`review-checklist.md` — 84 to 77.** The per-item review criteria, now grouped under five headings (PR shape and card relations, scope and changeset, test and gate evidence, assertions and benefit, premise/stop-condition/deletion). The three-leg rebuild measurement and the stop-condition incident are out; the criteria they supported stay, including the two required job names this file is pinned on.
- **`contract-review.md` — 68 to 60.** In-seat contract review: carrier discipline, ownership and eligibility, the downgrade fuse. All ruling dates and the parenthetical ruling citations are gone. The `Implemented-by:`/`Reviewed-by:` independence pair, the three landing pre-checks with the pair-checker's exit codes, and the transcript tier verification keep their spellings.
- **`landing-operations.md` — 80 to 69.** Sections A to D keep their letters, because SKILL.md points at them by letter. The regen trap, the queue-entry diagnosis order, the `Part of` close-out action, the post-merge reconciliation, the subscription lifecycle and the two main-red conventions all stay; their rationale tails do not.
- **`seat-post-protocol.md` — 104 to 91.** The four sections plus the ten-step handover checklist, which stays a numbered form. Thirteen lines that only restated SKILL.md's seat-post section are cut (read-side boundary, liveness-from-`updated_at`, race triad, epic delegation, job-description versioning).
- **`state-machine.md` — 44 to 42.** Per-state line contracts. The six-state set is now spelled out on its own line, and `Blocked-by:`, `Restart-when:`, `Restart-touch:` and `Unlock-action: re-check PR #M` keep their exact spellings and their line-anchored shape.
- **`decision-analysis.md` — 53 to 50.** Applicability, the standing adjudication-batch process, the filing template's six writing requirements, and the fixed facet-block shape. The facet tie-break order and the long-term weight floor are cut as duplicates of SKILL.md's escalation section. The frame is referred to by section name only; no fingerprint phrase appears.

**Ratchet.** The seven `CEILINGS` rows in `scripts/pm/check-skill-line-ratchet.mjs` are re-pinned down at the landed counts (241, 77, 60, 69, 91, 42, 50), each with a one-line note in the map's own convention. No other row moves and nothing is raised. The seven `MAX_TABLE_ROW_BYTES` rows stay at **0** — a measurement, not a disabled row: none of these files carries a markdown table, so a new table row would redden the pin. That is the reading taken on the house style's "lookup data stays in tables" clause (Table 4).
